newsitem.title: UK: Trafficmaster shares up on increased orders.
newsitem.headline: Trafficmaster shares up on increased orders.

text.p: Shares in live traffic information group Trafficmaster Plc rose on Wednesday after the company said Vauxhall Motors Ltd was increasing its orders for the Trafficmaster Oracle system.
By 0955 GMT, the shares were up 20p at 300p in trade of 85,000 shares.
The company said in a statement that Vauxhall would fit the Trafficmaster Oracle in a further 35,000 Vectra LS cars.
Vauxhall began fitting the unit as standard on its Vectra LS model in October 1996. Trafficmaster said Vauxhall plans to extend the use of the Oracle system to other models in 1997.

"Developments with other motor manufacturers are moving forward quickly and we expect to announce further orders for Oracle from both Vauxhall and other motor manufacturers during the course of the calendar year," said Trafficmaster chief executive David Martell.
